Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Mason All-Weather Wicker Dining Chair, Set of 2
Materials: Steel
Set of 2 all-weather chairs for dining outdoors in style Hand-woven, "commercial-grade", PE wicker with powder-coated steel frame - Weight Limit: 265 lbs Gently curved arm rests for comfort; seat cushions included; Approximately 1 hour assembly time Coordinates with matching Strathwood Mason dining table (sold separately) Measures 25.2 inches long by 23.22 inches wide by 35.63 inches high
